content: निरूढ {%a.%} .²1 Conventional, become current in popular usage, accepted (as the meaning of a word, as opposed to its यौगिक or etymological sense); द्यौर्न काचिदथवास्ति निरूढा सैव सा चलति यत्र हि चित्तम् <ls>N. 5. 57</ls>. .²2 Unmarried. .²3 Drawn out, purged. .{@-ढः@} .²1 Inherence (as of ‘redness’ in the word ‘red’). .²2 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) The accepted and popular meaning of a word.
